title: Opportunity Radar Signal Schema v1
description: Structured extraction contract for emotional market signals from raw social or qualitative research content.

source.description: Human-readable source reference, URL, file path, or source note.

platform.description: Platform or environment where the signal was observed.

raw_text.description: Original excerpt or manually captured source text.

emotion.description: Primary emotional category from the taxonomy.

pain_point.description: Concrete pain, frustration, anxiety, or unmet need.

pain_frequency.description: Estimated recurrence pattern, such as one-time, occasional, recurring, frequent, or constant.

social_behavior.description: Observed behavior, habit, coping mechanism, or social action.

identity_signal.description: What the signal suggests about self-image, status, belonging, aspiration, or identity.

shareability_score.description: Estimated likelihood that the signal motivates sharing, reposting, commenting, or forwarding.

monetization_score.description: Estimated willingness to pay or commercial opportunity strength.

retention_score.description: Estimated likelihood that the problem creates repeated product use.

possible_product.description: Possible product concepts suggested by the signal.

possible_hook.description: Possible acquisition, content, or positioning hooks suggested by the signal.

observed_patterns.description: Recurring patterns, repeated language, behaviors, or adjacent signals.

timestamp.description: ISO 8601 timestamp for when the signal was captured or extracted.
